items.headline: Inside India newsletter: Foreign flows helped the market recover. Now it faces the inflation test
items.summary: * Foreign investors have put in more than $10 billion, a record monthly sum, in Indian stocks so far in November. * Investors are shifting in favor of India because its economic growth has been resilient and strong improvement in corporate earnings.

items.headline: What lurks beneath India's strong quarterly earnings
items.summary: Summary Adjusted net profit of 3,835 companies rose 30% in Q2FY27, the fastest growth in three years, a Mint analysis showed. But rising input costs and limited pricing power could weigh on margins in the second half.

items.headline: Bank of England chief says interest rates not "pre-set"
items.summary: (Alliance News) - Interest rates are not on a "pre-set path" and policymakers will be keeping a "very close eye" on energy prices, the governor of the Bank of England has said amid speculation over imminent further hikes.
